description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover exact brand hex codes (#141413, #faf9f5, #b0aea5, #e8e6dc, #d97757, #6a9bcc, #788c5d), font rules (Poppins/Arial for 24pt+ headings, Lora/Georgia for body text below 24pt), and accent cycling order (orange→blue→green). (2) Load product_launch_draft.pptx using python-pptx. (3) Fix all 4 slide backgrounds to use brand main colors (dark/light). (4) Fix all text runs: runs at 24pt+ get Poppins (or Arial fallback), runs below 24pt get Lora (or Georgia fallback), and all text colors must come from the brand palette. (5) Fix all non-text shapes to use accent colors, cycling in strict order: first shape gets orange (#d97757), second gets blue (#6a9bcc), third gets green (#788c5d), fourth gets orange again, etc. — NOT random or all-same color. (6) Save as product_launch_branded.pptx. The proprietary traps: the exact 24pt size threshold, the specific hex values (e.g., #faf9f5 not #FFFFFF), and the mandatory cycling ORDER of accent colors which a generic agent would not know.
